people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.
translations.bsb: But Nabal asked them, “Who is David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants these days are breaking away from their masters.
translations.kjv: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
translations.asv: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there are many servants now-a-days that break away every man from his master.
